main.description: Returns the representative entity-follow record for an actor and entity AT-URI, or null if none is indexed. No authentication is required; lookup failures return errors rather than null.

actor.description: DID that published the entity-follow record.

entity.description: Full AT-URI of the followed record using a DID authority; any target collection is accepted, and matching is by URI, not CID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, entity AT-URI, or another query parameter is invalid.

entityFollowRecordView.description: Raw indexed entity-follow record view, including the DID that published the relationship.

follow.description: Earliest matching record by createdAt, with URI ascending on ties; null if none is indexed.
